suites.name: playwright (e2e)
suites.why_red: BC-01 tenant isolation. 3 of 14 fail because a staff member of Client B can open Client A workspace, activity feed (real prospect address + subject) and outbound email detail. The product has NO cross-staff tenant isolation - getAccessibleClientIds discards its staff argument. This is by design and Greg decided on 2026-08-23 not to build isolation, separating the pilot at the deployment level instead. BC-01 therefore asserts a property the product deliberately does not have, and will stay red until either isolation is built or the spec is formally deferred by Greg. It is NOT a flake and must not be quieted.
